Services, treatments & chemicals

Support the full service catalog—not just recurring general pest.

Recurring 30 / 60 / 90-day pest control is one part of the business. PestMoto also supports specialty services and keeps the CRM structure clear between what the customer buys, what the technician performs, and what products are used.

Recurring General Pest30 / 60 / 90-day plans
TermiteInspections, treatments, monitoring
MosquitoRecurring or seasonal service
Bed BugInspection and treatment programs
Rodent ControlMonitoring, trapping, baiting
Pest ExclusionEntry-point repair and prevention
German RoachTargeted interior treatment
FleaInterior / exterior treatment
Fire AntMound or broadcast treatment
WaspNest treatment and removal

Service → Treatment → Chemical

1Service

The customer-facing plan or job: Quarterly Pest Control, Termite Treatment, Mosquito Service, Bed Bug Treatment, Exclusion, and more.

2Treatment

The work performed: web sweep, exterior spray, weep-hole injection, granulation, baiting, trapping, crack-and-crevice work, inspection, etc.

3Chemical / Product

The product tied to the treatment, including default rate, quantity, method, and inventory deduction.

Example: Quarterly Pest Control can include Web Sweep + Exterior Spray + Weep-Hole Injection + Granulation, with each treatment connected to its own product and application record.
Real mapping + service configuration

Use a real map for the territory—not a decorative map mockup.

PestMoto's operations map is built around real map data so the office can work with customers, scheduled stops, technician locations, and routes in geographic context. Service configuration stays separate and follows the same structure used throughout the platform: Service → Treatment → Chemical.
